```yaml
name: Advanced Translation Check

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '**/*.arb'
      - '.github/scripts/**'
      - '.github/workflows/advanced-translation-check.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '**/*.arb'
      - '.github/scripts/**'
      - '.github/workflows/advanced-translation-check.yml'

jobs:
  translation-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install translate-toolkit

      - name: Install gettext
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y gettext

      - name: Run translate-toolkit quality checks
        run: |
          python .github/scripts/translate_toolkit_check.py

      - name: Run advanced translation checks
        run: |
          python .github/scripts/advanced_translation_check.py

      - name: Compile PO files to validate syntax
        run: |
          find . -name '*.po' -exec msgfmt -c -o /dev/null {} \;

      - name: Report failure if any checks failed
        if: failure()
        run: echo "Translation checks failed. Please review the logs."
```
